verdict.rationale: BILL documents a comprehensive sandbox for testing workflows without moving real money. Its API recipes, which explicitly include Spend & Expense users, budgets and cards, are run with sandbox account credentials. The sandbox documentation's worked example is AP-focused, though, so S&E-specific sandbox coverage is only implied. missing for 10: explicit documentation of S&E card/transaction behavior in the sandbox, details on sandbox provisioning/data isolation or reset, independent or hands-on corroboration.
